name: rka
description: Research Knowledge Agent (RKA) integration for Claude Code. Connects Claude to a local RKA backend for provenance-tracked research workflows: journal entries, decisions, literature, missions, claims, evidence clusters, and a research graph shared across four role skills (Brain in Claude Desktop or Code, Executor in Claude Code, PI human researcher, Writer for manuscript drafting in per-manuscript VSCode workspaces). The agentic-branch distribution ALSO ships the LangGraph orchestrator surface — rka-orchestrator MCP server with both mission-execution and per-project onboarding subgraphs, orchestrator-pi skill, and slash commands /orchestrator-start, /orchestrator-inbox, /orchestrator-status, /orchestrator-onboard, /orchestrator-manifest — for driving Brain⇄Executor⇄PI workflows directly from Claude Code, including a one-time per-project tool-discovery wizard that produces tools.json + .env under ~/rka-projects/. Activates on RKA, research notes, knowledge graph, decisions, missions, journal entries, evidence clusters, literature, organizing research, tracking provenance, knowledge base, manuscript drafting, LaTeX, venue selection, orchestrator, LangGraph, ratification, PI inbox, onboarding, project setup, tool manifest.
